verdict.rationale: stagewise has its own plugin system that connects the agent to external services and extends its context. The documented integrations are GitHub (issues, pull requests, actions), Supabase and Figma, so connecting to workflow tools is a real product capability. However, none of the story's named examples (Jira, Slack, Google Drive) appear in the evidence, and there is no generic connector mechanism documented. Missing for 10: Jira integration, Slack integration, Google Drive integration, a documented way to add arbitrary workflow-tool connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration of plugin use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: GitHub: Repository access, issues, pull requests, actions. Supabase: Database queries, edge functions, migrations
